name: Cajun Baked Salmon Rice Bowls with Corn and Peppers

components.name: Cajun Salmon
steps: Heat oven to 215 C. Mix oil and Cajun seasoning, then coat dried salmon fillets.
Place salmon in oven when vegetables are halfway through; roast fish until thickest centre reaches 63 C, about 12-18 minutes depending on thickness.
Portion five rice bowls with cooked vegetables and one salmon portion, refrigerating quickly; add lime and coriander just before eating.

components.name: Jasmine Rice
steps: Rinse dry rice and cook with measured water on stovetop, cover and rest 10 minutes before fluffing.

components.name: Roasted Corn & Peppers
steps: On a separate tray toss pepper, corn and onion with measured oil; roast vegetables about 15 minutes.
